```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# LEGEND NUMBERS — helper
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
LEGEND_FILE <- "SuppFigure4_legend_numbers.txt"
cat("Supplementary Figure 4 - legend numbers\nGenerated: ", format(Sys.time()), "\n",
    file = LEGEND_FILE, sep = "")
legend_out <- function(title, x = NULL) {
  body <- if (is.null(x)) character(0) else if (is.character(x)) x
          else utils::capture.output(print(as.data.frame(x), row.names = FALSE))
  txt <- c("", paste0("=== ", title, " ==="), body)
  cat(txt, sep = "\n"); cat(txt, sep = "\n", file = LEGEND_FILE, append = TRUE)
  invisible(NULL)
}
```

```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# a — sequencing depth before cleaning, with the read-depth cut-off
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Reads the pre-cleaning statistics file used by the data-cleaning notebook
# (MM_KN_stats_final_2026.txt), so the histogram shows every sequenced sample,
# including those later removed.
# CUTOFF matches the cut-off applied in 01_data_cleaning.Rmd.
RAW_META   <- "MM_KN_stats_final_2026.txt"
ID_COL     <- "KN_ID"
READ_COL   <- "Clean_reads_P1"
CUTOFF     <- 3e6
INFANT_ONLY <- TRUE   # the cleaning notebook plots the "^B" samples only

raw <- readr::read_tsv(RAW_META, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% as.data.frame()
rownames(raw) <- raw[[ID_COL]]
stopifnot(READ_COL %in% colnames(raw))
raw[[READ_COL]] <- as.numeric(as.character(raw[[READ_COL]]))
raw <- raw[!is.na(raw[[READ_COL]]), , drop = FALSE]
if (INFANT_ONLY) raw <- raw[grepl("^B", rownames(raw)), , drop = FALSE]

below <- sum(raw[[READ_COL]] < CUTOFF)
legend_out("Supp 4a — sequencing depth before cleaning",
           sprintf("file: %s | samples plotted: %s | below %.1f million: %d (%.1f%%) | at or above: %d | median %.2f million, range %.2f-%.2f million",
                   RAW_META, if (INFANT_ONLY) "infant only" else "all",
                   CUTOFF / 1e6, below, 100 * below / nrow(raw),
                   nrow(raw) - below, median(raw[[READ_COL]]) / 1e6,
                   min(raw[[READ_COL]]) / 1e6, max(raw[[READ_COL]]) / 1e6))
legend_out("Supp 4a — cut-off applied in 01_data_cleaning.Rmd",
           "3,000,000 clean reads, with N300_00_11A7 retained as an exception.")
if (below == 0)
  warning("No sample falls below the cut-off - check that RAW_META is the ",
          "pre-cleaning statistics file.", call. = FALSE)

p_a <- ggplot(raw, aes(.data[[READ_COL]] / 1e6)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 60, fill = "#4a3aa7", colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = CUTOFF / 1e6, linetype = "dashed",
             colour = "#e76f51", linewidth = 0.7) +
  annotate("text", x = CUTOFF / 1e6, y = Inf,
           label = sprintf(" %.0f million", CUTOFF / 1e6),
           hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.5, size = 3.5, colour = "#e76f51") +
  labs(x = "Clean reads (millions)", y = "Samples") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)
print(p_a)
ggsave("S4a_read_depth_histogram.pdf", p_a, width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# b — PCoA of Aitchison distances, all sample types
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Infant, maternal, probiotic product and the sequencing controls together, so
# the controls can be seen to sit apart from the biological samples.
PREV_ABUNDANCE <- 0.01   # % relative abundance counted as detected
PREV_MIN_SAMP  <- 5      # a species is kept if detected in >= this many samples

metadata     <- read.delim("metadata_cleaned_april.txt")
taxa_cleaned <- read.delim("taxa_cleaned_jan.txt")
rownames(taxa_cleaned) <- taxa_cleaned$ID; taxa_cleaned$ID <- NULL
rownames(metadata) <- metadata$ID

sp <- taxa_cleaned[, grep("s__", colnames(taxa_cleaned)), drop = FALSE]
sp <- sp[, !grepl("t__", colnames(sp)), drop = FALSE]
colnames(sp) <- gsub(".*s__", "", colnames(sp))
sp <- sp %>% mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric))

ids  <- intersect(rownames(metadata), rownames(sp))
meta <- metadata[ids, , drop = FALSE]
sp   <- sp[ids, , drop = FALSE]
meta$SampleType <- factor(trimws(as.character(meta$SampleType)),
                          levels = c("infant", "maternal", "probiotic",
                                     "positive", "negative"))

legend_out("Supp 4b — samples by type (all sequenced samples with a taxonomic profile)",
           meta %>% count(SampleType, name = "n_samples"))

# A control with no species at all cannot be placed in an ordination.
empty <- rownames(sp)[rowSums(sp, na.rm = TRUE) == 0]
if (length(empty)) {
  legend_out("Supp 4b — samples with no species detected (excluded from the PCoA)",
             meta[empty, , drop = FALSE] %>%
               transmute(ID, SampleType) %>% arrange(SampleType))
  keep_ids <- setdiff(rownames(sp), empty)
  sp <- sp[keep_ids, , drop = FALSE]; meta <- meta[keep_ids, , drop = FALSE]
}

detected <- colSums(sp > PREV_ABUNDANCE, na.rm = TRUE)
sp_keep  <- sp[, detected >= PREV_MIN_SAMP, drop = FALSE]
pseudo   <- min(sp_keep[sp_keep != 0]) / 2
dist_all <- vegdist(sp_keep, method = "aitchison", pseudocount = pseudo)

pcoa <- cmdscale(dist_all, k = 2, eig = TRUE)
vv   <- round(pcoa$eig * 100 / sum(pcoa$eig), 2)
pdf_df <- as.data.frame(pcoa$points) %>% setNames(c("PC1", "PC2")) %>%
  rownames_to_column(".sample") %>%
  left_join(tibble(.sample = rownames(meta), SampleType = meta$SampleType),
            by = ".sample")

TYPE_COLS <- c(infant = "#3288BD", maternal = "#A6DDB7", probiotic = "#5AAE61",
               positive = "#D4B3E9", negative = "#F97B72")

p_b <- ggplot(pdf_df, aes(PC1, PC2, colour = SampleType, fill = SampleType)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.85) +
  # Ellipses only for the groups large enough to support one.
  stat_ellipse(data = ~ subset(.x, SampleType %in%
                 names(which(table(pdf_df$SampleType) >= 10))),
               aes(group = SampleType), type = "t", linetype = 2,
               geom = "path", show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_manual(name = "Sample type", values = TYPE_COLS, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Sample type", values = TYPE_COLS, drop = FALSE) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4))) +
  labs(x = paste0("PCo1 = ", vv[1], "%"), y = paste0("PCo2 = ", vv[2], "%")) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", panel.grid = element_blank())

p_b <- ggExtra::ggMarginal(p_b, type = "histogram", groupColour = FALSE,
                           groupFill = TRUE,
                           xparams = list(bins = 60, alpha = 0.8,
                                          position = "identity", color = "white"),
                           yparams = list(bins = 60, alpha = 0.8,
                                          position = "identity", color = "white"))
print(p_b)
ggsave("S4b_PCoA_sample_type.pdf", p_b, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300)

legend_out("Supp 4b — ordination",
           sprintf("%d samples | %d of %d species (detected above %.2f%% in >= %d samples) | PCo1 %.2f%%, PCo2 %.2f%%",
                   nrow(sp_keep), ncol(sp_keep), ncol(sp), PREV_ABUNDANCE,
                   PREV_MIN_SAMP, vv[1], vv[2]))

# Do the sample types separate? Controls are few, so this is descriptive.
set.seed(42)
ad <- adonis2(dist_all ~ SampleType, data = meta, permutations = 10000,
              by = "margin")
legend_out("Supp 4b — PERMANOVA, sample type (10,000 permutations)",
           sprintf("n = %d | Df = %d | R2 = %.4f | F = %.2f | p = %.3g",
                   nrow(sp_keep), ad["SampleType", "Df"], ad["SampleType", "R2"],
                   ad["SampleType", "F"], ad["SampleType", "Pr(>F)"]))

cat("\n✓ Saved: S4a, S4b and ", LEGEND_FILE, "\n", sep = "")
sessionInfo()
```
